name: Nighttime Whispers in the Echoing Woods
4-piece_bonus: After using an Elemental Skill, gain a 20% Geo DMG Bonus for 10s. When under a shield granted by the Crystallize reaction, or when Moondrifts formed by Lunar-Crystallize reactions are nearby, the above effect is increased by 150%. When these conditions are no longer met, this additional increase disappears after 1s.

modifiers.label: Geo DMG Bonus After Using an Elemental Skill
Additional Geo DMG Bonus with a Crystallize Shield or Nearby Lunar-Crystallize Moondrifts (Expires 1s After Neither Condition Is Met)
